notes.title: Automaton Arena vA0.94.00 is Live! Happy (belated) pride month!
notes.content:
New Things:
Upgraded bot loadouts structure so lots of customization can be added in the future!Added 20 selectable prides for bots! (press (Menu) select and / or special on a bots style to get started! )Bots get a special flag reflecting active pride!Beam Welder's visuals change based on active pride!RightInc and RightOff arenas change visuals to reflect the prides of active players!
Improvements Made?
Feeble attempts were made to contain BallBot's dark quantum properties, but their rain of chaos continues unfettered
Bugs Squashed:
A handful of small bugs and crashes



Thank you so much for your continued support! Development of single player content begins now! I hope you look forward to it!

If you have any questions or concerns feel free to leave a comment, or let me know at:
Email!
Twitter!
Discord!

notes.title: Automaton Arena vA0.93.00 is Live!
notes.content:
New Things:
New in-game announcer! (Voiced by Nikatine!)Two new variant arenas!New weapon! (Beam Welder!)In-match teams!
Improvements Made:
Bot PMa is now unlocked by default!  (If you already have PMa, you will be given back the difference! Thank you for your dedication! <3)AI now understand how to reliably exit thingsRight Inc. and Right Off. BGM has been re-arranged for additional enjoyment!You can now long-press / long-click menu items instead of just using the (Menu) Special inputA mountain of minuscule miscellaneous other changes!
Bugs Squashed:
LOTSBallBot's charge sound can no longer persist from previous matches

Thank you so much for your continued support!
If you have any questions or concerns feel free to leave a comment, or let me know at:
Email!
Twitter!
Discord!
